content: iOS Safari pointer event quirks: (1) pointercancel can fire mid-gesture during ambiguous horizontal/vertical panning unless touch-action constrains the axis explicitly; (2) getCoalescedEvents (iOS 18.2+) is incomplete (missing pointerId/target) — avoid relying on it; (3) touch-action CSS must be set declaratively per-element (e.g. touch-action: pan-y or none) BEFORE JS gesture logic runs, as the browser resolves default touch behavior from CSS ahead of JS event handling, independent of preventDefault() calls in handlers.
